Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Communications Officer (maternity cover) position at IEEP. With a background in digital marketing, web design, and content management, I am excited about the opportunity to support IEEP's communications activities and contribute to its mission in European environmental policy.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra. I am proficient in HubSpot, WordPress, and Elementor, and have experience with analytics tools like Google Analytics and Search Console. My project mirook.com demonstrates my ability to create engaging visual content and implement structured data for improved visibility.

I am organized, able to coordinate multiple deadlines, and comfortable working in small, international teams. I am an EU citizen and currently reside in Belgium, with a valid work authorization.

I am enthusiastic about IEEP's work and would be thrilled to contribute during this period. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Communications Officer (maternity cover) position at IEEP. With a strong foundation in digital communications, web management, and content creation, I am eager to support IEEP's communications activities and contribute to its impactful work in European environmental policy.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have honed skills directly relevant to this position. I manage on-page SEO for client websites, write keyword-targeted blog content, and build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and the Astra theme. I am comfortable with website and newsletter management, social media coordination, and analytics reporting. My experience with tools like Google Analytics, Search Console, SEMrush, and Ahrefs enables me to monitor and report on communications performance effectively.

My project mirook.com showcases my ability to create engaging visual content and promotional materials. I designed and built a multi-page WordPress site, implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema), and integrated social media channels. This project demonstrates my initiative and ability to work independently while delivering high-quality results.

I am particularly drawn to IEEP's mission and the opportunity to work within a small, international team. My organizational skills and ability to manage multiple deadlines will allow me to quickly integrate and handle the varied communications workload. I am an EU citizen and currently reside in Belgium, with valid work authorization.

I am excited about the possibility of contributing to IEEP's communications during this maternity-cover period and am available to start in mid-October. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my skills can benefit your team.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
